trust_vs_agreement_r.note: Pearson r between trust_score and (y_pred == y_true). Near zero means trust is largely independent of model agreement.

budget_curve.note: targeting_efficiency is capped at 1/base_disagreement_rate, and reaches it whenever every routed parcel is a disagreement; routing by P(label wrong) x area lets a few agreeing parcels in, so it can sit just below the cap. Either way it measures coverage, not ranking quality, and establishes nothing about which side of a disagreement is correct.

visit_cost_assumption.note: Assumption. Derived from 3,204 capture events over a ~7-day survey window across 21 villages in the supplied sample; revise with FarmwiseAI's actuals.

auto_clear.assumption: Assumption. Derived from 3,204 capture events over a ~7-day survey window across 21 villages in the supplied sample; revise with FarmwiseAI's actuals.
auto_clear.residual_note: Auto-clearing fails only when the satellite and the surveyor err in the SAME way. That quantity is UNIDENTIFIED from this data: the calibrator was fitted against the declared label, so 1 - calibrated confidence estimates the probability of an event CONFIRMED already conditions on. It is offered as a rough proxy, NOT a bound, and can only be settled by an independent field audit of a CONFIRMED sample.
